description: Lists transactional DeFi vaults across EVM chains via LI.FI Earn. Filter by chainId, asset symbol, protocol name, or minimum TVL. Returns APY, TVL, underlying tokens and vault token address needed for the earn-deposit tool. Cursor-paginated. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

asset.description: Underlying token symbol or address (e.g. USDC, WETH)

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (e.g. 8453 for Base, 137 for Polygon)

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: earn_vaults
